items.quote: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
items.claim: Exodus 34:35 says the Israelites saw that the skin of Moses' face shone. It also says Moses covered his face with a veil again until he next went in to speak with God.
items.action: put the vail upon his face again
items.mechanism: Moses wore the veil in front of the people and took it off when he went in to speak with him (God, going by the passage around this verse).
